title: Oceanic Peruvian Floral Ceviche-Clasico
description: A show-off Peruvian ceviche dish featuring floral notes, cheese-pull, and starch. Perfect for a dinner party or special occasion.
instructions: Cut the raw halibut fillets into small pieces and place in a large bowl.
In a separate bowl, mix together purple cabbage, red onion, and fresh cilantro.
Add the mixed vegetables to the halibut and toss to combine.
Squeeze the lime juice over the halibut mixture and toss to coat.
Mince the garlic cloves and mix with the halibut mixture.
Season the halibut mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, crumble the queso fresco over the top of the halibut mixture.
Heat the coconut oil in a small skillet over medium heat.
Add the chili peppers to the skillet and cook for 1 minute on each side.
Remove the skillet from the heat and sprinkle the toasted chili peppers over the top of the ceviche.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and sprinkle a small amount of corn flour over the bottom of the skillet.
Add a small amount of halibut mixture to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
Serve the coated ceviche hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
